person_action: Create a task, subtask, copy of a task, or a task from a comment
Rename a task and change its dates, priority, size, tags or description
Move a task to another column or board
note: Column moves have no AI chat tool

person_action: Assign a task to a person or agent
Archive, delete or bulk-archive tasks
note: Gap HTPR-8215: /mcp/tasks is GET only and the CLI has no task archive or delete

person_action: Mark a task blocked by a person, blocking, or clear the red border
note: Accept, decline and duplicate-mark have no door

person_action: Link tasks as related, remove a subtask, view subtasks
Follow, star, mark unread or set a reminder on a task
note: Gap HTPR-8217: no follow, star or reminder door

person_action: Send a task to the inbox
Reply to a ticket or write a comment
Edit a comment
Delete a comment
React to a comment or like it
Pin or star a comment
note: Gap HTPR-8218: no pin or star door

person_action: Archive inbox items, triage or clear the inbox
note: One task per call; no bulk inbox archive door

person_action: Create a board or team
note: Creating a team has no door

person_action: Rename, archive or delete a board, change its settings
note: Join-link copy and reset have no door; delete goes through the CLI only

person_action: Search tasks and jump to a task
Board velocity report and generated status update
note: Gap HTPR-8219: pieces exist for hand-written reports only

person_action: Add, rename, hide or delete a board column
Select all tickets in a column or on the board
note: Selection is a screen state; agents act on one ticket at a time

person_action: Create, rename, merge or apply tags
Create a custom field and set its value on a task
note: AI chat can set a value but cannot create the field

person_action: Save, switch and manage board views
Start, stop or log time on a task
Create, update or delete a report
Create, edit, archive or delete a page
note: Snippets are skills: create_skill covers them

person_action: Create, rename, revoke or archive an agent
Invite or remove team and board members
Share a task publicly or copy its public link
note: Gap HTPR-8216: no public share door

person_action: Filter, sort or group the board and switch table columns
note: Screen state and saved-view settings; no door needed

person_action: AI chat controls: open, pin, switch mode, add agent, delete sessions
Settings panes, AI model picks, API keys, notifications and plans
Go to a screen, switch the app shell or expand the sidebar
Theme, layout and zoom switches
Subscribe the board calendar in Google Calendar
Copy a link, ID or comment text to the clipboard
Expand, collapse or copy a comment thread
